_comment: Copy to config.json next to this file (or mount it at /data/userbot/config.json). The session file it creates IS the account - keep both out of git and off shared storage.
_owner: Numeric Telegram user id the bot calls and takes orders from. Get it from @userinfobot. Nothing else is obeyed.
_gateway: Control plane, used read-only to discover lines and their SIP parameters.
_sip: An external SIP account created in the WebUI under SIM Config -> External SIP accounts. The dialplan already rings every external account on an incoming call, so this is all the userbot needs to be reachable. Leave sip_password empty: the gateway hands out the account's own password, so there is nothing to keep in sync. sip_line empty = the first configured line.
_dial_allowlist: Optional. Empty = any number may be dialled. A compromised sidecar can place calls, so pin this down if the numbers you call are predictable.
